review:
A cat explorer raiding an ancient temple on 5x3, 25 lines. Catdiana herself lands as wilds of different sizes – small, medium or a full reel – and the big ones can hit several lines at once.

Ark scatters trigger free spins, and six coins start a Coin Respin with three jackpots. Medium-high volatility, 2,500x max and free spins roughly once every 208 spins. It plays a lot like Elvis Frog in Vegas with a temple theme. RTP is 95.3%, lower than most newer BGaming games.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
